title: Quick Steamed Chinese Rice Noodles
description: A comforting and crunchy Chinese dish featuring rice noodles, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner, and the anti-inflammatory properties of ginger and turmeric make it a great option for those looking for a healthy meal.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
While the noodles are cooking, heat the vegetable oil in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the turmeric and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Once the noodles are cooked, drain them and immediately submerge them in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Add the chopped scallions and sesame seeds to the bowl and stir to combine.
Drain the noodles from the ice bath and add them to the bowl, tossing to combine with the sauce.
Transfer the noodles to a tandoor clay pot and serve immediately.
